description: Negative, derived from AGSC-02-01: an opening line whose block is never closed by a later `---` is AGSC-E102. The file opens with `---` on line 1 and holds the keys of a valid concept, then its body, and no later line is `---`. The fault is reported on line 1, the opening line whose block never closes. A body line such as `## Intent` does not close the block, so a reader must not guess where the frontmatter ends; it reports this one error.
